| A | B | C |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | The tool shed keeps spades, forks and a wheelbarrow with a spare tyre. | Compost is turned once a week and covered when frost is forecast. A rain barrel at each corner collects water from the shelter roof. |
| 2 | Seedlings start in the cold frame and move out after the last frost. | ok |
| 3 | Paths between the beds are wide enough for a wheelbarrow to pass. | ok |
| 4 | The bench by the pond is a good place to sort seed packets. | Each season ends with a shared meal and a swap of saved seeds. The lighthouse lamp turns once every twelve seconds. |
| 5 | Keepers logged the wind direction at the top of every hour. | ok |
| 6 | A brass barometer hangs beside the stairs to the lantern room. | ok |
| 7 | Fog signals sounded in groups of two when visibility dropped. | The station records temperature, pressure and humidity each minute. Readings older than a year move to the archive drive. |

| 9 | Brake pads wear faster in wet weather and on long descents. | ok |
